note: Researched 24 Oct 2026 for the funding check. Not loaded by the app and not part of bursaries.json (the bursary tests expect exactly five bursaries, each with a closing date). Criteria use the key names in funding_check_reference.py. Re-check dates before the final submission.

bursaries.name: DSI-NRF Postgraduate Scholarship (2027 funding)
bursaries.whoItsFor: Honours, master's and doctoral students with a 65% average in their previous degree. Applications go through your university.
documents: See the application and funding guide on your university's postgraduate office page.
bursaries.notes: Honours (General): NRF closing date 23 Nov 2026, but your university's internal date is earlier (for example UCT 31 Oct, CPUT 16 Nov). First-time master's and doctoral calls closed in mid-2026 (3 July in the UKZN notice, earlier at some universities). Age limits of 28, 30 and 32 are applied when awards are allocated, not as a cut-off when applying. A financial means test decides full or partial cost. No NRF page was opened; details come from several university notices quoting the call.

needsCheck: Apply through your university's postgraduate office. Its internal closing date is earlier than the NRF date.
Age limits (28 honours, 30 master's, 32 doctoral) are applied when awards are allocated, not when you apply.
Citizenship or permanent residence, and the financial means test that decides full or partial cost.

bursaries.name: UNISA Postgraduate Bursary 2027
bursaries.whoItsFor: Students registered at UNISA for a postgraduate diploma, honours, master's or doctoral degree. New honours applicants are UNISA graduates with a 60% average over their whole undergraduate qualification.
documents: Apply online. Read the bursary guidelines and terms on the UNISA page first.
bursaries.notes: Applications for 2027 run from 21 Sep to 30 Nov 2026 (UNISA page). Honours and postgraduate diploma: South African citizens; new applicants must have completed an NQF 7 qualification by 31 Jan 2027; priority goes to higher averages. Master's and doctoral: South African and international students; returning master's students must have registered for the first time no more than three years ago. Research allowance amounts were not confirmed and are left out.

needsCheck: You must be registered at UNISA. New honours applicants need an NQF 7 qualification completed by 31 January 2027.
South African citizenship for honours (master's and doctoral include international students).

bursaries.name: IDC External Bursary Scheme 2027
bursaries.whoItsFor: Unemployed South African citizens aged 26 or younger with financial need, studying full time at a public university or university of technology. Mainly first undergraduate qualifications.
documents: Certified copies of identity and household documents. See the IDC advert for the full list.
bursaries.notes: CLOSED: applications ran from 1 June to 30 Sep 2026 (IDC page). Postgraduate funding only for selected honours fields: law, mathematics, statistics, actuarial science and accounting CTA. Does not ordinarily fund a second undergraduate qualification.

needsCheck: Must be unemployed, with financial need.
Mainly first undergraduate qualifications. Postgraduate only for selected honours fields (law, mathematics, statistics, actuarial science, accounting CTA).

bursaries.name: SANSA Postgraduate Bursary 2027
bursaries.whoItsFor: South African honours, master's and doctoral students in science, engineering and technology fields linked to space, with an average of at least 65% in their last year of study.
documents: Certified ID (certified within three months of applying)
Draft proposal for master's (up to 2 pages) or doctoral (up to 4 pages), signed by applicant and supervisor
Lecturer or supervisor testimonial (master's and doctoral)
bursaries.notes: CLOSED: applications closed 30 Sep 2026. Funding is capped at R150,000 (honours), R160,000 (master's) and R170,000 (doctoral) per year. The 65% rule is on the SANSA page; the closing date and citizenship rule come from a university announcement and other sites.

needsCheck: Study must fit SANSA's space science, earth observation or space engineering areas.

bursaries.name: Canon Collins RMTF Scholarship 2027
bursaries.whoItsFor: Master's and PhD students at South African universities who are citizens of an eligible Southern African country, in justice, education policy or humanities fields.
documents: Draft research proposal and supervisor letter (PhD)
bursaries.notes: CLOSED: deadline was 14 Aug 2026 (4:00 pm GMT, which is 18:00 South African time; some sites wrongly say 16:00 SAST). Awards are R20,000 to R100,000, not full cost. Master's funding up to two years, PhD up to three.

needsCheck: Citizen of an eligible Southern African country, living there.
At least 2 years of social justice involvement and a good honours degree.

bursaries.name: ISFAP postgraduate funding (honours via NRF)
bursaries.whoItsFor: Honours students whose NRF applications need an ISFAP financial assessment.
documents: ISFAP application consent form (see your university's postgraduate office).
bursaries.notes: CLOSED for 2027: honours applicants needing ISFAP assessment had to apply by 24 Aug 2026 (UCT and NRF notices). No ISFAP page was opened. Check isfap.org.za for later calls.
